Aero 1.2.75: work survives closing Aero, and tasks can run on a schedule.

## Install or update

Aero 1.0, 1.1 and 1.2 offer this update at startup (**Update now**). New installs:

| System | File | Then |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Windows** 10 / 11 (64-bit) | `Aero-windows.zip` | Extract it, double-click `Update-Aero.bat`, accept the admin prompt. `--dest D:\Aero` installs elsewhere; `--lean` skips setting up the integrations now (Aero finishes them in the background). |
| **macOS** (Apple Silicon or Intel) | `Aero-macos.zip` | Unzip it, right-click `Install-Aero.command` → Open. |
| **Linux**, any distro | `install.sh` | `curl -fsSL https://github.com/NermalYT/Aero/releases/latest/download/install.sh \| sh` |
| Debian, Ubuntu, Mint, Pop!_OS | `aero_1.2.75_all.deb` | `sudo apt install ./aero_1.2.75_all.deb` |
| Fedora, RHEL, Rocky, Alma, openSUSE | `aero-1.2.75-1.noarch.rpm` | `sudo dnf install ./aero-1.2.75-1.noarch.rpm` |
| Arch, Manjaro, EndeavourOS | `PKGBUILD` | `makepkg -si` |
| Any Linux, by hand | `Aero-linux.tar.gz` | `sh Aero/install.sh` |

Models, chats, memory, settings, keys, tunings, skills and mods carry over.

## What's new

- **Resume interrupted work.** If Aero closes or crashes in the middle of a task or forever-loop, the sidebar's new **Tasks** lists it. One click resumes it, and the model is told what was already done and what wasn't.
- **Scheduled tasks.** Ask Aero ("every weekday at 8, check my email and GitHub") or add one under Tasks: once, every few minutes or hours, daily, weekdays, or weekly.
  - Each run gets its own chat, or continues one chat.
  - Runs wait while you're chatting.
  - Actions that need your OK are queued in the run's chat for you to approve.
  - Creating a scheduled task always asks you first.
  - Your mouse and keyboard are never used.

Full list: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/NermalYT/Aero/blob/main/source/CHANGELOG.md).
